name: form-engine
title: Form Engine
author: Bevel UI <hello@bevelui.com>
description: A fully-engineered config-driven form system supporting single-step and multi-step flows. Features a six-hook plugin system, react-hook-form + zod integration, composable API, RTL support, and a zero-config shortcut component.
docs: Import from @/components/bevelui/form-engine. Use FormEngine for the zero-config shortcut or compose manually with FormEngineRoot, FormEngineProgress, FormEngineStepMeta, FormEngineStepCanvas, and FormEngineActions.
